description: Reminder tools: schedule a message to be delivered to the user at a future time, list open reminders, cancel one.

schedule_reminder.description: Schedule a reminder that is delivered to the user, word for word, at a future time (no AI is involved when it fires). Use it when the user says 'remind me …'. Read the day and time off the 'Now' line and the calendar in the context note at the end of the user's message (in the user's timezone); never use the shell or web search for dates. A time the user states always wins: '8pm' is 20:00. Only when they give no time: 'tomorrow morning' = 09:00, 'afternoon' = 14:00, 'evening' = 18:00, 'tonight' = 20:00. Pass either 'when' (one-off) or 'cron' (recurring), never both. Do not pass 'timezone' unless the user named a place or zone: the user's own zone is applied. Pass 'connector' only if the user named a channel (e.g. 'telegram'); otherwise omit it. The result states the exact time, timezone and channel: repeat all three to the user exactly as returned. If this tool returns an error, the reminder was NOT saved: tell the user.

message.description: What to remind the user of, written as the text they will receive, e.g. 'Call the bank'.

when.description: One-off local date and time as 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM', e.g. '2026-10-18 20:00' (in the user's timezone; no offset needed). Must be in the future.

cron.description: Recurring schedule as a 5-field cron expression (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week), e.g. '0 9 * * 1' for every Monday 09:00. Not more often than every 15 minutes.

until.description: Optional end of a recurring reminder, same format as 'when'.

timezone.description: IANA zone name. Omit it: the user's own timezone is used. Set it only when the user names a different place or zone.

connector.description: Optional channel type, e.g. 'telegram'. Omit to use the user's default reminder channel.

list_reminders.description: List the user's open (not yet delivered) reminders with their ids, times and channels. Use it to answer 'what reminders do I have?' or to find the id to cancel.

cancel_reminder.description: Cancel an open reminder by id (get ids from list_reminders).
